high_level_description: This image is of a Pokémon card titled "Infernape." The card is from the "XY" expansion set, as indicated by the "XY" logo at the bottom left corner. The card number is 104/172, and it is part of the "Stage 2" series, as shown by the text at the top left. Card Design: The card features an illustration of Infernape, a fire-type Pokémon, in action. It appears to be mid-jump or leaping, with its arms outstretched and legs bent, suggesting movement
